diagnosis: The OAuth2 account linking strategy callback extracts targetUserId from req.query.state without verifying that targetUserId matches the currently authenticated session user (req.user.id) or validating a secure anti-CSRF state nonce. An attacker can link their own GitHub account to a victim's user ID and subsequently log in via GitHub OAuth to take over the account.
exploit_request:
GET /auth/github/callback?code=gh_oauth_code_8892&state=usr_victim_account_4401 HTTP/1.1
Host: devportal.cloudtools.com
Cookie: session=<attacker_cookie>
